data.title: Damac Lagoons Views
data.about:
Welcome to the newest addition at Damac Lagoons by Damac Properties, where the first-ever apartment buildings in the Damac Lagoons Community are now unveiled. These buildings, known as Damac Lagoons Views, represent a continuation of the success story of the Damac Lagoon Villa community. 

They are masterpieces of architectural design and innovation, standing out with their striking facades and breathtaking views. Experience a unique Mediterranean lifestyle in these elegantly crafted 1 to 2 bedroom apartments, each offering stunning waterfront views. Perfectly positioned opposite Damac Hills, the Damac Lagoons location transcends the concept of a traditional home, evolving into a holiday-like destination. 

Living in Damac Lagoons means embracing each day as a vacation. In addition to the apartments, the community offers a variety of Damac Lagoons townhouses and villas for sale, providing luxurious homes for the discerning few who seek unparalleled elegance and comfort.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Waterfront Living at Damac Lagoons Views
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• First in Damac Lagoons: Unveiling first ever apartments in the esteemed Damac Lagoons Community.
  • Architectural Excellence: Innovative design inspired by the success of Damac Lagoon Villa community.
  • Breathtaking Views: Apartments with striking façades and stunning panoramas.
  • Mediterranean Charm: Elegant 1 to 2 bedroom apartments with a Mediterranean flair.
  • Waterfront Serenity: Picturesque waterfront living opposite Damac Hills.
  • Diverse Clusters: Eight Mediterranean-themed areas, each with unique features.
  • Resort-Style Living: Enjoy beaches, lagoons, and leisure amenities.
  • Exclusive Residences: Premium townhouses and villas also available for sale.
  • Vacation-Like Lifestyle: Every day feels like a holiday in this serene setting.

location_tile.title: The Ultimate Location in Damac Hills
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled between Emirates Road (E611) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), this splendid waterfront neighborhood boasts an excellent location. With direct access to the city's main thoroughfares, Damac Lagoons offers a prime position just across from Damac Hills, ensuring seamless connectivity to the wider city.

  • 10 mins – Damac Hills | Dubai Autodrome
  • 12 mins – Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club | Dubai Sports City
  • 22 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 35 mins – Dubai International Airport
